analysis: Independent arithmetic over every original NPZ; no evaluator/readout imports or new environment steps. Time thirds and hold/shield diagnostics are retrospective descriptions, not causal estimands.

integrity.rng_limit: Full RNG state streams and initial raw state were not retained; their recorded digests agree. Complete user arrays and their digests were independently reconstructed.

Both paths agree with the native formula at float64 roundoff. Source and raw records were not changed.

cost.limits: Per-process peaks are not a simultaneous aggregate. Worker timing includes differing trajectories and scoring; scorer-only CPU is not isolated. Some startup/import and engineering/review/publication/readback, including the first assertion and its inspection, is unmetered.
